summary.headline: Judgments on Wealth and Fortune
summary.text: Astrological judgments about wealth and fortune: the Part of Fortune in the eleventh sign, combustion of the lord of substance or Part of Fortune, conjunctions and adverse aspects with benefics or malefics, and applications involving the ascendant, second place, triplicity lords, Part of Substance, and Jupiter.
